Bakku bakku baku~n! Need something from Chloe?
Bakku bakku baku~n! I'm Sakamata Chloe, an orca, and the cleaner-slash-intern of Secret Society holoX.
There's a city of Chloe's pod nearby. Wanna stop by? …Oh, and don't peek into Chloe's room, okay?
Sure, sure! I've been kinda curious about your city. Got any good food?
Looks like we're pretty far apart. Wanna swap maps? Not sure you can read Chloe's handwriting, though.
Sorry, but you just made it onto Chloe's cleanup list. …Bakku bakku baku~n.
Huh? Picking on the new hire? …Fine. Chloe's really good at cleaning.
Noooo, come on… Chloe hasn't even sung enough yet!
Noooo, come on… Chloe hasn't even sung enough yet!
Hey, Chloe wants to be friends with you. …N-not that it means anything, okay!
Yay! Then we're friends starting today! …If you cheat on me, you're getting cleaned up, though, okay?
Huh… so you don't like me…? …Hmph. Fine, whatever.
Huh, you want to be friends with Chloe? Ugh, fine, if you insist~ I'll be nice to you!
Ohhh~? Aren't we a little early for that? We're not that close yet~
Hey, why not join Chloe's pod? Orcas hunt in packs, you know.
All right, now we're the same pod! Chloe'll watch your back.
Oh… so you're a lone orca, huh? Tell me anytime if you get lonely.
Sure! Chloe's more of a protect-others type than a be-protected type.
Hmm, it's a bit early to let you into the pod. Let Chloe watch how it goes a little longer, okay?
Heeey… isn't that kind of awful? Chloe's gonna tell everyone.
Huh, you hate Chloe…? …Hmph. If that's how you want it, I'm not holding back.
Your country's kinda nice! Chloe kinda likes it. …Just a little, though.
Watching what you've been up to lately is getting Chloe really irritated. …Be careful, okay?
Can Chloe send a delegation from her pod? They'll take a bath first, promise.
Thanks! Fish as a gift is fine, right?
Huh, no? …But I said they'd take a bath.
Sure, come on in! I'll show you around — anywhere but Chloe's room.
Sorry, it's kind of a mess right now… not exactly presentable.
Let Chloe set up an embassy over there. I'll send a cleaning person along, too.
Deal! I'll pick somewhere nice to live.
Heeey… why not~?
Sure. Don't make a mess… though Chloe's the last one who should say that.
Not yet. Chloe's secrets aren't something you get to peek at that easily.
Wanna open our borders so we can come and go freely?
Yay! Now Chloe can come visit anytime!
Hmph. Chloe's the type to hold a grudge, you know.
Sure~. But if you peek anywhere weird, I'll smack you, okay?
Nooo, no, no! I haven't forgiven you that much yet!
If it's about money, I'm all for it! Let's do it.
Ohhh~? Did you really think Chloe would nod at that?
So close! Let Chloe tweak this part a little? How about this?
Deal~! You get it, don't you?
Heeey… I thought it was a good offer, though~
…Hey, shall we wrap this up? Chloe's getting sleepy.
Yeah, that works. The cleanup ends here.
What? Shut up, seriously. As if I'd accept terms like that.
Whew… now I can finally get some proper sleep.
If that's how you want it, Chloe will clean you up all the way to the end.
…Fine, just this once. Chloe's the big sister, after all.
No, no, no! I'm never giving it to you!
That's what I like about you! …Just a little, though.
Hmph… Chloe remembers these things, you know?
That's Chloe's pod's territory, you know? If you get any closer… you get it, right?
Good, that's better. ♪
…Hmph. Then let's start by cleaning up the territory.
Huh, was it that close? Sorry, sorry — I'm bad at reading maps.
The sea doesn't belong to anybody, you know~?
Could you not teach my pod weird stuff?
Mm, thanks.
…I'm done with you. Chloe holds grudges, you know?
Okay~. …When you love something, you just can't help spreading it, you know?
Aw, but you want to spread good things, right? You'll get into it eventually, too.
Hey, could you stop digging up Chloe's land without asking?
Thanks. That's all I wanted you to understand.
Aw, you did it. …One more for the cleanup list.
Huh, that was your land? Sorry, I totally didn't notice…
It was buried, so it belongs to whoever finds it, right?
Could you stop sneaking around looking at me? That's Chloe's specialty, you know.
Good. Nice and honest.
Hmph. Then let's start by cleaning up your spies.
…Busted? Sorry, I won't do it again. …Probably.
You're saying that to a cleaner? Gathering intel is part of the job.
Hey, aren't you lining up too many troops on the border? Seeing that makes Chloe want to clean up.
Glad you understand. …You got lucky, huh?
Oh, sorry! They were only here to clean up the barbarians.
Wherever my kids are is Chloe's business, isn't it?

Need something from Kazama, I daresay?
hololive 6th gen, Secret Society holoX's insurance policy, Kazama Iroha here, I daresay!
There's a Kazama Tai village nearby, I daresay. Wanna stop by?
Much obliged! I'd love to visit. I'm looking forward to your city!
Wow, that's pretty far~. Wanna swap maps? Kazama gets lost super easily, so…
No hard feelings, but it's all part of the job, I daresay. …Here I come!
Are you serious? …I'll take that fight, I daresay. Don't underestimate Chakimaru, okay?
Whyyy~… Kazama was still in the middle of training!
Whyyy~… Kazama was still in the middle of training!
That way of doing things… Kazama can't really let it slide, y'know?
Huh… did Kazama do something? …If that's how you feel, I know what I'll do, I daresay.
I feel like we'd get along! Wanna be friends with Kazama?
Yay! We're friends starting today! If you're ever in trouble, I'll come running right away, I daresay.
Whyyy~? …Oh, I see. Then, maybe next time, please.
If you're fine with Kazama, I'd be glad to! Please take care of me from now on!
Hmm, I don't really know you well yet, you know? Let me watch for a little while longer, I daresay.
I feel like I could trust you to watch my back. Wanna form an alliance with Kazama?
Much obliged! From now on we sink or swim together. Kazama will protect you, I daresay.
Oh… I won't force you. If you change your mind, just say so anytime.
Of course! I'm used to bodyguard work, so leave it to me!
It's a generous offer, but I can't decide yet. Kazama has reasons too, so…
Your country's really nice! Kazama likes it~
I've been a bit worried about you lately… You should be careful, I daresay.
Can Kazama Tai send envoys over? We'll have them bring Gozaru cookies as a gift.
Thanks! Please take good care of our envoys.
Whyyy~? …I even baked cookies.
Welcome! I'll show you around the Kazama Tai village… if we don't get lost, I daresay.
Sorry, it's not a great time right now…
Could Kazama Tai set up a residence in your country? We'll do our duties properly, I daresay.
Much obliged! I'm gonna take a good look around your country!
Whyyy~? …Did Kazama do something rude?
Sure. The Kazama Tai village is full of mountain delicacies, so make yourself at home!
Sorry, I can't allow that much yet, I daresay.
Wanna open our borders so we can come and go freely? Kazama loves traveling!
Yay! Now I can go see all kinds of places!
Oh… what a shame, I daresay.
Sure. But if you make trouble, Kazama will punish you, okay?
Nope nope nope~. I don't trust you that much yet.
Much obliged, those terms are fine. …Way better pay than a 5-yen chocolate, I daresay.
Okay, I really can't accept that one. Don't underestimate Kazama, I daresay.
So close! Can I fix just this part a little? How about this?
Deal! Genius, no?
Oh… I thought it was a good deal, though.
More fighting is pointless for both of us, I daresay. Shall we sheathe our swords?
Those terms are fine. I'll sheathe my sword.
There's no way I'd accept terms like that! Kazama is angry, I daresay.
Thank you very much… Now I can finally catch my breath, I daresay.
I see. Then I'll take you on to the very end!
Oh, what am I going to do with you, I daresay… Just this once, okay?
I can't do that one. Kazama has things to protect too, so…
Much obliged! You're an understanding person, I daresay.
I see… I'll remember this, okay?
That's our territory, I daresay. I'd like you to stop coming any closer.
Thanks for understanding~
…I see. Then I've got my own plans, I daresay.
Was it that close? Sorry, I'm bad at reading maps…
Doesn't this land belong to no one? I think Kazama has a right to live here too.
Please don't just go preaching to my team members!
Much obliged, that helps a lot, I daresay.
…If you're going to say that, Kazama can't stay quiet either, I daresay.
Oh, was that a bother? Sorry, I'll be more careful from now on, I daresay.
I think it's a good teaching, though. I won't force you, but…
Please don't dig up Kazama Tai's land without asking!
Thanks for understanding!
…You'll be giving back everything you dug up, I daresay.
Was that your land? I'm so sorry, I didn't notice, I daresay.
Whatever comes out of the ground belongs to whoever finds it, right?
Please stop sneaking a peek at us~
Good! Nice and honest!
…Then I won't go easy on you, okay?
…Busted? Sorry~ I won't do it again~
Gathering information is part of a bodyguard's job too, I daresay.
Aren't there too many of your troops gathering at the border? Kazama can't help feeling uneasy, y'know.
I'm relieved you understand, I daresay.
Oh, sorry. We only came to take care of the barbarians, I daresay.
Wherever our team is, that's up to Kazama, isn't it?
